title: Bridging the Structural Gap: Adapting Autoregressive Generation for Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2607.21028v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) has emerged as a new paradigm for sequential recommendation, in which a representative line of work encodes items into hierarchical semantic IDs via residual quantization and predicts the IDs token by token. However, this generative formulation still exhibits structural gaps with respect to the recommendation task: flattening multi-token IDs into a single sequence destroys item-level structure, and the inconsistency between training and inference over a hierarchical codebook gives rise to semantic drift. translated_title: 弥合结构差距：自适应自回归生成用于推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）已成为序列推荐的一种新范式，其中代表性工作通过残差量化将项目编码为层次化语义ID，并逐词预测这些ID。然而，这种生成式表述在推荐任务中仍存在结构差距：将多词ID展平为单个序列会破坏项目级结构，而层次化码本上训练与推理之间的不一致性导致语义漂移。为弥合这两个差距，我们提出BARGE，它采用项目上下文感知注意力（ICA）在编码过程中恢复项目级结构，并利用层次化路径重排序（HPR）结合双路径解码（DPD）在解码过程中从两个互补角度抑制语义漂移。在公开基准和大型离线测试上的广泛实验和分析研究表明，该方法显著提升了性能。
tldr: 本文提出BARGE方法，通过项目上下文感知注意力恢复项目级结构，并采用层次化路径重排序和双路径解码抑制语义漂移，有效弥合了生成式推荐中的结构差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BARGE, which restores item-level structure via item context-aware attention and suppresses semantic drift through hierarchical path reranking and dual-path decoding, effectively bridging structural gaps in generative recommendation.
